method: Production root with public fictional world. Three isolated contexts per viewport for cold HTTP/SW caches, followed by same-context reload after verified Service Worker control. CDP emulates 150ms latency and 1.6Mbps down/0.75Mbps up on the page and, through a second CDP client that auto-attaches before each service worker runs, on every service worker; no CPU throttling. A sample counts only if its navigation took at least the emulated latency from fetchStart to responseEnd, and warm samples also need every context's service worker throttled. No Playwright routing (which would disable HTTP cache). FCP is browser Paint Timing; world ready is observed from the actual scene state. No slow samples removed.
